title: pleopeltis pteropus
intro: Pleopeltis pteropus, commonly known as the resurrection fern, is a type of epiphytic plant species that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its unique ability to survive for long periods without water by drying out and rehydrating when water becomes available. Pleopeltis pteropus is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular protective effects.
